about:
Skippy Foods operates from Little Rock, Arkansas, where it has produced peanut butter since 1933. The company's founding details and ownership structure are not disclosed in the available information.

The manufacturer produces a range of peanut-based products including creamy peanut butter, natural peanut butter spreads, P.B. Bites, squeeze packs, and a squeeze Greek yogurt snack cup. Specific production processes, facility size, headcount, and volume metrics are not provided.

The brand serves consumer markets directly, describing its audience as "peanut butter enthusiasts everywhere" and emphasizing a global fan base. No industrial or B2B customer segments are identified in the source material.

The company positions its product as a source of joy and a "way of life," citing 80 years of experience and the iconic teal jar as central to its identity. It states that fans act as "tastemakers" guiding the brand.
built_on: 80 years of peanut butter manufacturing experience
type_evidence: We know a few things about making delicious peanut butter after 80 years in business
